title: CORE-02 Generic Model Qualification: Benchmark Lab Suites and Qualified Routing for Core Capabilities
purpose: Qualify local models on CORE-01 generic capabilities (classify, summarize, extract) via Benchmark Lab evaluation suites, evidence promotion, and qualification records to enable qualification-driven routing in multi-track workflows.
problem: CORE-01 created 6 generic capabilities and 4 multi-track workflows, but no local models are qualified for generic tracks. Workflows currently rely on deterministic tools or screening models without statistical qualification guarantees.

included: Benchmark Lab suite core-classify-v1 (category adherence, non-hallucination, structured output)
Benchmark Lab suite core-summarize-v1 (bounded compression, key point extraction, schema adherence)
Benchmark Lab suite core-extract-v1 (structured JSON extraction matching caller-supplied schemas)
Semantic evaluators and test fixtures with easy, medium, and adversarial strata for all 3 suites
Model qualification records for llama3.2-local across the 3 generic tracks with canonical checksums
Local Brain Capability Registry and Qualification Resolver registration for core capabilities
Qualification-aware routing in core tracks and multi-track workflows (repo_review, text_qa, document_review, content_os)
excluded: Modifying existing completed Lighthouse or DealSniper qualification evidence

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: benchmark-lab/locaily/tracks/core-classify/ (suite, cases, mock responses, scenarios.js); verified with benchmark-run.js and test:core02.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: benchmark-lab/locaily/tracks/core-summarize/ (suite, cases, mock responses, scenarios.js); verified with benchmark-run.js and test:core02.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tool-router and run-plan-executor resolve qualified model and attach qualificationRecordId in Track Run Records across all 4 workflows; verified in test:core02.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: npm run test:full passed 100% across all 19 test suites.
